notes.elevation: per-segment gain_m/loss_m follow the stored orientation (20 m DEM samples, 2 m hysteresis). A road's gain/loss is the sum over its segments, so climb_total_m (gain + loss) is the direction-free number to show.
notes.goal: island_total_m is the denominator for 'every road on Bainbridge': centerline metres of every segment the rule counts (see `rule`), each segment once. Private roads, named service lanes and driveways are in the dataset but not in the total.
notes.island_total: island_total_shippable_m counts only segments whose geometry may ship (OSM/ODbL). Agency-only geometry stays in data/roads/canonical/private/.
